title: search_urls reads only Microsoft Learn's results list, so a GitHub or arXiv search that answers 200 is recorded as no answer, not as no hit
goal: factdiff.search_urls takes a 200 search answer as one only when its JSON is an object with a results list (Learn's shape), but providers.csv gives github, github-blob, arxiv and pypi a search_api whose answers provider.SEARCH_SHAPES parses (items for GitHub, Atom XML for arXiv): since BG-gx5b2yhu each such 200 answer is recorded unanswered, so a moved or not-found line of those sources keeps the offline stamp instead of a verdict, and before it their hits were never read. search_urls reads each provider's answer by its known shape (provider.search_shape), treats only an answer outside that shape as no result list, and a 200 with an empty list of the provider's shape stays an answer with no hits. Found by the SP-vdrsfftl review of BG-gx5b2yhu.

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import factdiff as f, provider as p; p.request=lambda u, **k: {'status':200,'body':'{"total_count":0,"items":[]}','headers':{}}; f.search_urls('Get-Thing returns a value', None, {'search_api':'https://api.github.com/search/code?q={q}&per_page=10'}, 'https://github.com/o/r/blob/main/x.md'); sys.exit(1 if [r for r in f._unanswered if 'api.github.com' in r] else 0)
